title: Enhancer-driven cell type comparison reveals similarities between the mammalian and bird pallium.
authors: Hecker, Nikolai; Kempynck, Niklas; Mauduit, David; Abaffyova, Darina; Vandepoel, Roel; Dieltiens, Sam; Borm, Lars; Sarropoulos, Ioannis; Gonzalez-Blas, Carmen Bravo; De Man, Julie; Davie, Kristofer; Leysen, Elke; Vandensteen, Jeroen; Moors, Rani; Hulselmans, Gert; Lim, Lynette; De Wit, Joris; Christiaens, Valerie; Poovathingal, Suresh; Aerts, Stein
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习解析增强子编码并跨物种比较端脑细胞类型，虽涉及转录因子调控的增强子序列，但核心是细胞类型比较而非TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法可迁移但对象和互作深度有限。
abstract: Combinations of transcription factors govern the identity of cell types, which is reflected by genomic enhancer codes. We used deep learning to characterize these enhancer codes and devised three metrics to compare cell types in the telencephalon across amniotes. To this end, we generated single-cell multiome and spatially resolved transcriptomics data of the chicken telencephalon. Enhancer codes of orthologous nonneuronal and gamma-aminobutyric acid-mediated (GABAergic) cell types show a high degree of similarity across amniotes, whereas excitatory neurons of the mammalian neocortex and avian pallium exhibit varying degrees of similarity. Enhancer codes of avian mesopallial neurons are most similar to those of mammalian deep-layer neurons. With this study, we present generally applicable deep learning approaches to characterize and compare cell types on the basis of genomic regulatory sequences.
abstract_zh: 转录因子组合决定细胞类型的身份，这反映在基因组增强子编码中。我们利用深度学习来表征这些增强子编码，并设计了三个指标，以比较羊膜动物端脑中的细胞类型。为此，我们生成了鸡端脑的单细胞多组学和空间分辨转录组学数据。直系同源的非神经元和γ-氨基丁酸介导的（GABAergic）细胞类型的增强子编码在羊膜动物间显示出高度相似性，而哺乳动物新皮层和鸟类脑皮层中的兴奋性神经元则表现出不同程度的相似性。鸟类中脑皮层神经元的增强子编码与哺乳动物深层神经元最为相似。通过这项研究，我们提出了普遍适用的深度学习方法，基于基因组调控序列来表征和比较细胞类型。
